summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Studio City International Holdings Ltd, a foreign issuer, furnishing the annual report of its subsidiary Studio City Finance Limited for the year ended December 31, 2025. The filing contains audited financial statements and related disclosures but does not announce any transaction, corporate action, or special situation. It is a routine periodic report with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event.
